latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Image To Video skill.

- Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF images (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos using cloud GPUs.
- Supports animated slideshows with transitions, background music, text overlays, and more.
- Simple onboarding: auto-connects and grants 100 free credits for new users.
- Seamless upload, edit, preview, and export workflow; process takes 30–90 seconds per video.
- Full guidance on supported commands, usage tips, and API error handling provided.
